Episode Notes:
Ankit is joined by Grant Christopher of VERTIC. Grant has done extensive open-source work tracking North Korea's centrifuge halls and enrichment output. Together they map the known enrichment sites and work through what the latest imagery suggests about how much material North Korean leader Kim Jong Un now commands. The conversation closes on the harder question of what, if anything, could still shape where the program is heading.
